name: fibcalc
//: No `go install ...@latest` here (audit PRO-02): a binary installed once goes stale against the toolchain and fails silently, which is what happened to golangci-lint, govulncheck, gosec and staticcheck. Every tool is pinned in scripts/tools.env and invoked with `go run <pkg>@<version>` by the gates and the Makefile. libgmp-dev is still installed so check.sh step 3b (-tags gmp) actually runs here.
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libgmp-dev build-essential
